cases.narrative: After being read his Miranda rights, he told the deputy that he wanted to give his mother the most painless death possible. He said he first grabbed his mother’s neck and tried to break it, but he wasn’t strong enough and tried to strangle her instead, the report said. He stabbed her and cut her throat, the deputy wrote, and then threw the knives into the garbage.
